description: Vorbehaltsgebiet Bau überörtliche Straßenbahn is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Principle in the regional plan, which serves to secure paths/area provisions, to extend the tram network of Dresden across municipalities or to be able to relieve tourist areas in the Kirnitzschtal from individual traffic. Data origin: - Regional Planning Association Upper Lusatia-Lower Silesia with legal basis Regional Plan, 1. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Reservation area Construction of supra-local tramway" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Zásada;U_20_6, Doprava;trasa, Kirnitzschtal, Trasse, Regionalplanerische Ausweisung, überörtlich. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
